capacitor.name: Charged Capacitor
capacitor.lore: Humming with stored current. The Capacitor Offering in the Dynamo Court wants it.

reactor_key.name: Reactor Key
reactor_key.lore: Opens the shielded door to the Stormheart Reactor.

waves.say: The rods crackle. Sparks take shape.

onDone.text: The current drains into a crystal. A Charged Capacitor lies on the plate.
The relay gate retracts. Wind and humming come from the ravine beyond.

mechanics.doneText: The bulbs steady. The relay is aligned.

onDone.text: The mast earths the storm. The ravine falls quiet.
A shielded panel slides back in the north wall.

mechanics.failText: The lamps drop out. The code reads red, blue, yellow, lime.

onOpen.text: The altar surges. The gate to the Capacitor Vault slides open.

mechanics.hint: A cradle of copper, shaped for a charged crystal.
mechanics.verb: seats the capacitor and the gate surges open.

onOpen.text: The shielded door to the Stormheart Reactor opens.

mechanics.hint: A shielded door with a copper keyway.
mechanics.verb: turns the Reactor Key and the shield door yawns open.

encounters.say: Coils spit along the walls. Something with circuits for a pulse is awake.
The rotor spins down. The colour code on the north wall: red, blue, yellow, lime.

bosses.name: The Stormheart
bosses.intro: The Stormheart wakes. Break the three charged pylons on the ring to ground it.
bosses.deathText: The Stormheart sputters out. The reactor falls silent.

shield.breakText: The pylons burn out! Strike the Stormheart now!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Stormheart calls its servants.

completion.intro: The Stormheart Works. Align the relay, cross the cable ravine, and bring a capacitor to the court.
completion.message: The current dies. The works close shortly.
